title: Iceberg settings (iceberg.toml)
description: Iceberg's settings file, ~/.config/grand-line/iceberg/iceberg.toml. Widget files in the widgets folder follow #/$defs/widget. Iceberg checks both on every load and lists problems in Settings; unknown keys are warned about there, so editors flag them too.

panel.description: What the panel shows, in order: built-in items (date, now-playing, today, reminders, battery, shelf) and widget file names without .toml.

open_on.description: Open the panel when the pointer rests on the notch, or when it is clicked.

hover_delay.description: Seconds the pointer rests on the notch before the panel opens.

close_delay.description: Seconds after the pointer leaves before the panel closes.

toggle_shortcut.description: A keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the panel from any app: ctrl, option, cmd or shift and a key, joined with +. An empty text turns it off.

external_displays.description: Displays without a notch: nothing, or a pill at the top centre.

live_activity.description: Artwork and playing bars beside the closed notch while music plays.

menu_bar_icon.description: Iceberg's item in the menu bar.

launch_at_login.description: Open Iceberg when you log in.

max_concurrent.description: The most widget commands that run at the same moment (and the most streams). Values outside 1 to 16 are brought into range.

no_notch_style.description: The closed shape on displays without a notch: a pill at the top centre ("island") or a black tab drawn like a MacBook's camera notch ("notch").

shelf_quick_actions.description: Zip, compress, convert and remove the background of files on the shelf. Results are new files beside the original; nothing is overwritten or deleted.

drag_basket.description: Shake the pointer while dragging a file to show a basket near it; what you drop there goes on the shelf.

hud_volume.description: Show the volume in the notch when it changes.

hud_brightness.description: Show the display brightness in the notch when it changes. Needs Accessibility, to see the brightness keys.

hud_battery.description: Show the battery in the notch when power is connected or removed, and when it falls to 20% and 10%.

hud_bluetooth.description: Show Bluetooth headphones (AirPods and others) connecting, with their battery when macOS knows it. Needs Bluetooth access.

hud_replace_system.description: Iceberg handles the volume and brightness keys itself, so macOS's own HUD does not show. Needs Accessibility; only for the HUDs turned on.

builtin.description: The older way to choose built-in items; panel replaces it.

widget.title: Iceberg widget file
widget.description: A file in ~/.config/grand-line/iceberg/widgets/ (TOML or JSON). Interval widgets use refresh, signal widgets signal = true, stream widgets stream = true.

command.description: The shell command whose output is shown. It runs with /bin/sh in the widgets folder. Its output is one line of text, or one line of JSON: text, alt, tooltip, class, percentage, icon, color.

title.description: The label. Defaults to the file name.

refresh.description: How often it runs: seconds (5 at the fewest), a duration such as "30s", "5m" or "1h", or "on open".

signal.description: Runs when `iceberg trigger NAME` is called (and once as the panel opens).

stream.description: The command keeps running and prints one line per update.

updates.description: "when_shown" runs it only while the panel is open, plus once as it opens; "always" keeps it current while the panel is closed.

always.description: Keep running during Low Power Mode and around sleep.

click.description: Run when the widget is clicked, then the widget refreshes.

timeout.description: Seconds before a stuck command and everything it started are stopped (1 to 120; values outside are brought into range).

order.description: Only for files from before panel: the position, lowest first.

enabled.description: false keeps it off, whatever Settings says.
